# FLX-3646: a conditions group leaves no row possible

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The values a group fixes are checked against the joint the emit's declared conditionals describe, with the exact arithmetic that draws the rest of each row. When the values are impossible together, because a weight table gives a combination no weight or two fixed values need a combination the tables rule out, there is no row to draw and `plan` refuses the group, naming it and its values. Change the values, or the declared weights.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3646
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
